# Ovlink

> [Ovlink](https://ovlink.sbs) is a modern, privacy-focused URL shortener, dynamic QR code generator, and real-time click analytics suite with instant Telegram and Discord bot integrations.

## Core Features
- **URL Shortening**: Instant link shortening with custom aliases, password protection, expiration dates, and UTM parameter builders.
- **Dynamic QR Code Generator**: High-resolution QR codes downloadable in PNG/SVG formats with custom styling.
- **Telegram Bot Integration**: @OvlinkBOT allows users to shorten links and generate QR codes directly in Telegram chats without opening a browser.
- **Real-Time Analytics**: Non-invasive click metrics, geographic location mapping (country & city), device breakdown (iOS, Android, Desktop), and referrer sources.
- **Developer API**: REST API with API key authentication, rate limits, and bulk shortening endpoints.
- **Multi-Language Support**: Available in Azerbaijani (AZ), Turkish (TR), English (EN), and Russian (RU).
- **Security**: Built-in malicious URL and phishing filters, CSP nonces, CSRF protection, and SSRF prevention.
